name: GitHub
tagline: Repos, issues, pull requests and Actions
description: Let agents browse code, open and review pull requests, triage issues and check Actions runs across your repositories, with the permissions of your own access token.
examples: Summarize the open pull requests on acme/web that wait for my review
Open an issue for the flaky checkout test with the failing log attached
Why did the last Actions run on main fail?

auth.tokenHelp: Create a fine-grained personal access token with only the repositories and permissions you need.

verification.notes: Endpoint from GitHub's documentation; live check 2026-11-14: unauthenticated initialize answers 401 with RFC 9728 metadata; authorization server github.com.
